## What

Describe the changes introduced in this pull request.

## Why

Explain the rationale, motivation, or issue addressed by this change.

## Verification

Describe how the changes were tested and verified.

Build and test command:
```bash
./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug assembleRelease
```

## Atomic-PR Checklist

- [ ] Encapsulates a single bug fix or feature.
- [ ] Minimal diff without unrelated cleanup or refactoring.
- [ ] Cosmetic or formatting changes are separated from functional changes.
